_doc: Image review configuration. Floors are provisional, calibrated on this box's own outputs (state/evidence/image_review_calibration_20261104.json). A missing scorer is never a pass: require_scorers=true turns it into needs_review.

thresholds._doc: pHash is primary; SSIM>=0.55 rescues the same picture under new light. Tighten from the owner's reference set, not from taste.

product_picture._doc: front 0.2412/21.375, back 0.2363/19.375; flat label artwork 0.1514/19.0 is refused on preference.

listing_image._doc: white-bg 0.2559/23.25. Note: the rubric-rejected white-bg renders score HIGH (0.2637/23.6), so preference does not replace the listing rubric; it only refuses a flat or off-brief render.

social_frame._doc: designed typography frames score low by nature (tiktok 0.1572/18.125); recorded, never blocking.

default._doc: an unnamed surface is measured but not blocked on preference; identity and legibility still block.
